mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% triggers a loss of consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or returns are not significantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 102.0 index points signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 5-quarter moving averages signals robust demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise above 5-quarter moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-positive when both proxies rise, or returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% reduces growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in the tightening regime, or returns are not significantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly jobless claims (PAYEMS) below 5.0 million indicates improving labor market conditions, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite decreasing PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 101.0 index points signals weakening economic momentum, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 101.0, or returns are not significantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-positive when both proxies rise, or returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
